1. Touch Red (top) - done
2. Move DOWN past Blue to Light Green (bottom) - touch it

This is possible because the trail moves with the player when moving UP/DOWN.
Let me try this: move DOWN to Light Green position, extend trail to touch it, ACTION7, then move UP to Blue position, extend trail to touch it, ACTION7.
But wait, I need to first retract the trail (LEFT) before moving DOWN, otherwise the trail might interfere. Actually, the trail moves with the player, so I can just move DOWN and the trail moves with me.
Actually, let me think about this more carefully. The trail is currently at the Red block position (row 19-22). The Light Green block is at row 31-34.
